rootCause: The rebuilt domain allocates different body IDs. Retaining the old tile mapping after replacing the physics world makes collider(0) address a body without colliders. The stable key is the course feature plus cell index, which maps to IDs in the incoming snapshot world; logical handoffs retain the receiving world mapping.

reproduction.method: The inherited baseline already contains the repair. A test-only preload reinstates stale-ID reuse by forcing keepBodies during full restores, without changing project source. This reproduces the original rbCollider wasm trap on the representative 60-seat season run.
